result.instructions: Private BackupAPI clones; source translation via existing DAV. Production tools/configuration are unchanged. No automatic-research lifecycle is claimed by this temporary test profile.

tools.name: research_contract
tools.description: Read current research principles before exploring or proposing a new theory.

tools.name: research_context
tools.description: Retrieve project evidence, failures and provenance (untrusted research data).

tools.name: attend
tools.description: Persist attention shift, linked to prior finding within same project.

tools.name: interpret
tools.description: Persist a new UNVERIFIED interpretation; claims are not accepted as proven.

tools.name: record_result
tools.description: Record hypothesis, failed check, counterexample or proof candidate; verified status is prohibited.

tools.name: research_focus_candidates
tools.description: List prior claims/failures available as new attention targets; not a search optimizer.

tools.name: audit_research_shift
tools.description:
Audit against sourced frontier constraints; never decide mathematical truth.

proposed_operation: mechanism, intent (experiment/transformation/proof),
premises[], mathematical_properties[], testable_consequence, required_evidence[].
verification_plan: method and failure_condition. preserved_properties maps
point_value, analytic_function, observables, source_provenance and
rule_applicability to separate claim/evidence_refs objects. Missing or
semantic evidence returns REQUIRES_SEMANTIC_REVIEW. Cosmetic names do
not change the structured fingerprint. Legacy text-only calls remain advisory.
evidence_roles maps cited event IDs to role and reason. Diagnostic or
label_error roles require a scoped local-operator disposition; the
caller cannot clear adverse evidence just by changing its role label.

tools.name: research_frontier
tools.description: Read current obligations and event-backed constraints before choosing a research move.

tools.name: research_obligation_create
tools.description: Create a versioned research obligation. Closure records research state, not a proof.

tools.name: research_obligation_update
tools.description: Append an obligation version; reopening requires explicit grounds and new source/evidence.

tools.name: research_obligation_history
tools.description: Read immutable obligation versions, including closure and reopening grounds.

tools.name: record_research_move
tools.description:
Save a deduplicated proposal and its separate audit; never activate it.

move requires active_frontier_id, active_frontier_version, scope,
parent_event_ids and the structured audit fields. Scope must match the
active obligation for experiment authorization. Cosmetic names do not
create another move. A request key cannot be reused with different data.
Hard audit failures are saved as REJECTED with no execution permission.

tools.name: research_move_history
tools.description: Read immutable status/audit history and current effective execution permission.

tools.name: audit_research_move
tools.description: Persist a fresh audit against current obligation versions; never activate execution.

tools.name: transition_research_move
tools.description:
Explicit lifecycle decision; only a currently audited bounded experiment can activate.

complete requires result(outcome, summary, optional data), reason and
at least one existing project-local event:N evidence_ref. FAILURE,
INCONCLUSIVE and ERROR are valid outcomes; no outcome verifies
mathematics. Changed obligation versions require audit_research_move.
Rejected, abandoned or completed proposals carry no execution permission.

tools.name: record_transformation_contract
tools.description:
Record source→operation→result and create five OPEN preservation obligations.

preservation must contain point_value, analytic_function, observables,
source_provenance and rule_applicability. Each entry needs statement and
optional evidence_refs. A reference does not establish preservation.

tools.name: propose_research_policy
tools.description: Request an explicit human-approved policy change; does not apply it.

tools.name: service_health
tools.description: Integrity and audit-chain check.

tools.name: dav_register_adapter
tools.description:
Register an allowlisted versioned CA/GraphBits/conditional-Gate6 descriptor. No Python/code/path input.

Writes only the isolated DAV store. Registration/audit never grants research execution.
A projected descriptor retains raw full states; audit may forbid a quotient interpretation.

tools.name: dav_observe
tools.description: Observe bounded original states and all operation outputs. Observations never imply a full-world proof.

tools.name: dav_check_law
tools.description:
Check a bound typed formula. proved is only adapter-relative finite/encoded semantics; never scientific verified.

Explicit states ALWAYS mean sampled evidence. Complete enumeration is determined internally.
Equality scope full_state/observation is explicit. Default computation writes no certificate.

tools.name: dav_generate_candidates
tools.description: Deterministic paged symbolic equation-implication proposals; no proof or neural policy implied.

tools.name: dav_reduce_library
tools.description:
Reduce checked laws by exact premise/conclusion vectors and subsumption; not a minimal axiom basis.

Partial candidate search is marked search_complete=false. Sample relations remain empirical.
Explicit persist saves one append-only library with its scope and evidence vectors.

tools.name: dav_find_counterexample
tools.description: Return a concrete raw-state violation and full replay steps, or an explicitly scoped undecided/proved result.

tools.name: dav_audit_adapter
tools.description: Audit total deterministic builtin semantics and projected observational congruence; return actual paired witness.

tools.name: dav_export_evidence
tools.description: Read project-local immutable evidence and effective binding validity; no grant, verification or raw DB exposure.

tools.name: artifact_translation_propose
tools.description:
Propose competing source-bound symbolic networks in private QA. No empirical verification or execution grant.

Input is relation data only; no code, raw artifact path, checker or hidden answer is accepted.
SEARCH_EXHAUSTED describes this bounded edit family, not scientific success.

tools.name: artifact_translation_check
tools.description:
Independently check source reverse traces; register valid descriptors in DAV and check scoped laws.

Optional local role repair retains the original conflict and adds a revision. Validity is
relative to declared textual B-relations, not verification of meaning or physical chemistry.

tools.name: artifact_translation_history
tools.description: Read project-local append-only proposal/check summaries and integrity, including original failures.
